topic: A person discovers the tree they planted as a child has been cut down
text: I remember the day we planted that tree, the soil under our knees, the sun warm on our backs. You were just a little thing, barely taller than the sapling. Over the years, I watched both of you grow. The tree, strong and tall, a sanctuary in the backyard, and you, branching out into the world, finding your own place under the sun. It's hard, seeing it gone. But remember, it’s not just the tree that marks your journey. It’s every memory, every laugh, and every moment spent under its shade. Those are the roots that run deep, in your heart. The tree’s spirit lives on in you, in how you’ve grown and flourished. It’s okay to grieve, but also, let’s celebrate all the good it gave us, shall we?
